instruction: Look at freecad_task-9_input.step in FreeCAD. Machine the solid block into a three-axis hydraulic manifold. Keep the 120 x 70 x 50 mm outer block. Cut a main through passage of diameter 18 mm along X, centered at Y=35 mm and Z=25 mm. Cut a vertical branch passage of diameter 16 mm along Z centered at X=60 mm, Y=35 mm, connecting through the block. Cut a side branch passage of diameter 12 mm along Y centered at X=90 mm and Z=25 mm, passing through both side faces. Cut four vertical mounting holes of diameter 8 mm at (18,16), (102,16), (18,54), and (102,54), each with a top counterbore diameter 18 mm and depth 8 mm. Add a shallow top gasket recess 62 x 34 mm centered at (60,35), 5 mm deep. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-9_output.step. Complete interactively in the FreeCAD GUI and do not use script files.
